versions.label: Version and module availability
command: const fs=require("node:fs"),p=require("node:path"); const wanted=JSON.parse(process.argv[1]); let result={node:process.version}; for(const id of wanted){const path=p.join(process.env.NODE_PATH,id,"package.json");require.resolve(id);result[id]=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(path,"utf8")).version;} console.log(JSON.stringify(result));
